title: Automatic Mixed Precision package - torch.amp
author: pytorch.org
summary: Torch.amp.autocast automatically chooses the best data type for operations to improve performance during training and inference. For CUDA, use torch.amp.autocast("cuda") with float16, and for CPU, use torch.amp.autocast("cpu") with bfloat16. When leaving autocast regions, convert tensors back to float32 to avoid type errors.
